source: Sources: Costco CFO, 2015 earnings call (Seattle Times); WSJ 2018

scenes.text: Costco gives up millions of dollars a year on a chicken. On purpose.
scenes.head: MILLIONS. ON A CHICKEN.

scenes.text: That rotisserie chicken has cost $4.99 since 2009.
scenes.say: That rotisserie chicken has cost four ninety-nine since two thousand nine.
scenes.head: SAME PRICE SINCE 2009

scenes.text: In 2015, their finance chief said they'd eat $30 to $40 million a year to keep it there.
scenes.say: In twenty fifteen, their finance chief said they'd eat thirty to forty million dollars a year to keep it there.
scenes.head: "WE'LL EAT IT"

scenes.text: And where is it? All the way in the back of the store.
scenes.head: ALL THE WAY IN THE BACK

scenes.text: So you walk past everything else first. Heh... that's not dinner. That's bait.
scenes.head: THAT'S BAIT

scenes.text: So... do you ever leave with just the chicken?
scenes.head: JUST THE CHICKEN?

scenes.text: Nobody does, and that's exactly why...
scenes.head: NOBODY DOES
